title: Federated SAC verification experiment on gravity-heterogeneous Pendulum-v1
machine: WSL2 laptop, 16 CPU cores, NVIDIA RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (runs executed on CPU)

algorithm_config.twin_critics: independently initialized instances (a deepcopied second critic would degenerate the clipped double-Q mechanism)

federation_config.fedprox_scope: actor parameters only (value networks are never pulled towards old global weights)

evaluation.envs: each client evaluates on its own gravity
evaluation.note: evaluation returns are not comparable across clients

calibration_local_only_baseline.description: single-process SAC, 60k environment steps each, one seed (0)
calibration_local_only_baseline.verdict: all three gravities learn stably (random policy baseline is about -1500)

federation_results.metric: per-client mean over the last 6 evaluation rounds; mean and std across 3 seeds (unit: seed)

verdict: All four methods learn stably on all clients across all seeds, validating the federated infrastructure. No aggregation method separates from local_only at this heterogeneity level (gravity +/- 20%); stronger or differently structured heterogeneity, more seeds, and sample-efficiency metrics are required before any method can be claimed better.
